lines.intro: Mr. Pip, the arcade keeper, spins round with swirly eyes. "NOBODY beats my high scores!"
lines.command: How can Fae calm Mr. Pip?

soothe.great: Fae hums the arcade's little jingle, slow and soft. Mr. Pip's swirly eyes start to slow down!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. Mr. Pip stops mashing buttons for a moment.
soothe.miss: Mr. Pip beeps and boops right over Fae's humming.

play.great: Maddie bats a ping-pong ball round and round. Mr. Pip follows it, grinning!
play.good: Maddie pounces on a stray ticket. Mr. Pip chuckles.
play.miss: Maddie chases a blinking light and bumps into a gumball machine. Mr. Pip snorts.

cast.great: Sue swings her ribbon bobber like a claw machine claw. Mr. Pip cheers when it grabs a plush!
cast.good: Sue's bobber dangles and twirls. Mr. Pip leans in to watch.
cast.miss: Sue's line tangles round a joystick. Mr. Pip shakes his head.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pinecones in a perfect loop. "New high score!" Mr. Pip claps.
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone high. Mr. Pip's eyes follow it up and down.
juggle.miss: Jordan's pinecone bonks the claw machine. Mr. Pip doesn't even look up.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. Mr. Pip munches it between button mashes.
lines.burst: Mr. Pip mashes every button at once. A flurry of prize tickets and tokens flies at Fae!

burstResult.great: Fae catches every ticket, like confetti!
burstResult.good: Fae dodges most of the tokens!
burstResult.miss: Whoosh! Fae is buried in paper tickets.

lines.soothed: Mr. Pip blinks. The swirls fade from his eyes, and the arcade's beeping settles down.
lines.rest: Fae is dizzy from all the flashing lights. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae backs away. Mr. Pip keeps mashing buttons.
